title: Operating the Gassing Manifold
author: Roey Angel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.vcue2ww
materials: Flip the switch to turn on the controller.

steps.title: Prepare Syringe Filters and Needles
steps.instruction: Attach new needles to the syringe filters, ensuring needles are thick enough to penetrate stoppers but thin enough not to break them. Change syringe filters if working with sensitive samples to avoid contamination.

steps.title: Attach Vials to Manifold
steps.instruction: Attach the vials by piercing the stoppers with the needles, ensuring the needle does not touch the liquid inside the bottle.

steps.title: Configure Pressure Settings
steps.instruction: Set the pressure knobs without forcing them beyond their stopping points.

substeps.instruction: Turn the main pressure knob almost all the way through.
Turn on the pressure adjusting knob, typically setting it between 0.5 and 1 bar.

steps.title: Initiate Gassing Process
steps.instruction: Start the pump and open the specific valves connected to the vials while keeping all other valves closed.

substeps.instruction: Open the valves of the tubes to which vials were connected.

steps.title: Flush Vials
steps.instruction: Allow the vials to be flushed properly to become anoxic.

substeps.instruction: Perform longer degassing for vials containing liquids.
Test the required cycles when using a new set-up of vials.

steps.title: Pressurize Vials
steps.instruction: Turn off the controller switch and allow the vials to reach overpressure, as indicated by the pressure gauge above the controller.

steps.title: Shut Down Pump and Remove Vials
steps.instruction: Stop the pump and disconnect the samples.

substeps.instruction: Close the valves and remove the vials.

steps.title: Deactivate Pressure Knobs
steps.instruction: Turn off the pressure knobs without using excess force.

substeps.instruction: Turn off the main pressure knob.
Turn off the main pressure adjusting knob.

steps.title: Release System Pressure
steps.instruction: Release any remaining pressure in the system by quickly opening and closing one of the tube valves.
